title: Garmin: Health
description: Overnight vitals against your baseline, sleep, stress and Body Battery, daytime vitals and body measurements.

panels.title: Sleep stages
panels.description: Time per stage each night, against the sleep Garmin recommended for that night.

panels.title: HRV
panels.description: Overnight HRV. Garmin rates your HRV status as balanced while the 7-day average stays inside the shaded baseline range.

panels.title: Time per stress level
panels.description: Share of the day at each stress level (rest, low, medium, high), darkest = most stressed. Activity and unmeasured time are left out.

panels.title: Body composition
panels.description: From your latest smart-scale weigh-in. Values your scale doesn't measure are left out.
